texts.value: Acts as a structural scaffold that organizes free PP2Ac into a configuration that FBXO42 can recognize and ubiquitinate, leading to its proteasomal degradation (PubMed:41986709). Also interacts independently with PPP4C through a mechanism distinct from FBXO42-mediated ubiquitination (PubMed:41484364)
Interacts with FBXO42 and PPP2CA (PubMed:41484364, PubMed:41986709)
The protein has mostly an alpha helical conformation similar to myosin heavy-chain tail that might adopt a coiled-coil conformation
A chromosomal aberration involving CCDC6 is found in papillary thyroid carcinomas (PTCs). Inversion inv(10)(q11.2;q21) generates the RET/CCDC6 (PTC1) oncogene
